description: This file contains a utility function to map keyboard event key names to their corresponding Unicode or key codes used in the BiDi protocol for browser automation. It is part of the Playwright Core project's server-side Bidirectional (BiDi) support, specifically handling keyboard input translation.

methods.name: getBidiKeyValue
methods.description: Translates a key name string into its corresponding BiDi protocol key code or character, handling special keys and standard alphanumeric keys.
